urgency_label: Your dog looks healthy and happy!

body_condition.details: Good muscle tone visible, waist clearly defined from above, ribs palpable with slight fat cover

observations.note: Shiny, full coat with no patches or excessive shedding visible
Bright, clear eyes with no discharge or redness
Balanced stance, no favoring of limbs, head held naturally
Alert expression, engaged with environment, tail position relaxed

breed_risks: Hip dysplasia (common in retrievers, watch for stiffness after rest)
action_items: Schedule annual vet checkup if not done in last 12 months
Monitor weight quarterly since retrievers gain easily
Check ears weekly for redness or odor
voice_summary: Hey there! Your golden retriever looks great. Healthy weight, shiny coat, bright eyes, and good energy. Just keep an eye on those floppy ears for infections, and watch the portions since retrievers love to eat. Overall, you're doing a great job!
